authoring_qualification.before_rationale: Complete4638EH adds inadmissibility and deportability for conviction, admitted commission OR admitted essential-element acts under18USC1368. The retained complete offense unit concerns willful/malicious harm to a dog or horse employed by a federal agency in law-enforcement activities, not every animal or mere suspicion. The final EHincludes admission alternatives beyond the older title’s conviction wording; use its actual body, not a narrower title or earlier substitute. This is immigration/offense policy without a direct infrastructure, technical-system or research mechanism merely because a law-enforcement agency is involved. Proposed whole-action exclusion does not prove a person committed an offense, expand the federal-animal definition to all animals, certify all current immigration exceptions/process or infer automatic removal/admission outcomes. House passage is not enactment.
authoring_qualification.after_rationale: Complete4638EH adds inadmissibility and deportability for conviction, admitted commission OR admitted essential-element acts under18USC1368. The retained complete offense unit concerns willful/malicious harm, attempt or conspiracy involving a dog or horse employed by a federal agency principally for criminal-detection, law-enforcement or apprehension purposes, not every animal or mere suspicion. The final EHincludes admission alternatives beyond the older title’s conviction wording; use its actual body, not a narrower title or earlier substitute. This is immigration/offense policy without a direct infrastructure, technical-system or research mechanism merely because a law-enforcement agency is involved. Proposed whole-action exclusion does not prove a person committed an offense, expand the federal-animal definition to all animals, certify all current immigration exceptions/process or infer automatic removal/admission outcomes. House passage is not enactment.
